question: Why is the core of a transformer laminated instead of being made as a single solid piece? Explain with reference to eddy currents.

options.A: Lamination reduces eddy currents by breaking their paths and increasing their resistance, thereby reducing heating and energy loss.
options.B: Lamination increases eddy currents so that the transformer core becomes hotter.
options.C: Lamination eliminates hysteresis loss by making the core non-magnetic.
options.D: Lamination reduces the resistance of the core and allows larger eddy currents.
